reviews.title: Alhamdulillah! Finally an app that truly understands our struggle as Muslims
reviews.text:
As a brother striving to purify myself, I’ve long struggled to find a tool that helps with self-control while staying true to our Islamic values. This Deen Back app is truly a blessing from Allah!

First of all, the interface is clean and simple—no flashy distractions that could lead to temptation. What moves me most is how beautifully it combines faith with science-based addiction recovery. Every time I feel weak and about to slip, the app doesn’t just offer psychological tips—it also provides relevant Quranic verses and duas that instantly remind me that Allah is All-Seeing, helping me regain control over my nafs.

"Indeed, with hardship comes ease." The developers truly understand that what we pray for after every salah is exactly this: the strength to exercise self-restraint. The tracking system is well-designed too—watching my "clean days" grow gives me a real sense of achievement in my faith journey.

I highly recommend this to every brother and sister striving to maintain purity and guard themselves in a world full of temptations. May Allah reward the development team for this effort and guide us all to the straight path. Ameen.
